description: Figure 7 illustrates a comparison of loss values over training steps for two experiments (Ex1 and Ex2) during the Embedding and LM Head training stage, shown as a line plot with four series. The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 60,000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 10,000-step intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from 0 to 12×10⁻¹ (about 0 to 1.2), with tick labels shown in scientific notation at roughly 2×10⁻¹ increments (e.g., 2×10⁻¹, 4×10⁻¹, …, 12×10⁻¹). The Ex1 Loss series is a blue solid line with circular markers that drops sharply early (from roughly 0.35 near the start to about 0.20 by around 5,000 steps) and then gradually decreases to about 0.18 by 60,000 steps. The Ex2 Loss series is a darker blue solid line with circular markers that starts higher (around 0.40 near the beginning), declines to roughly 0.30 by about 5,000–10,000 steps, and then remains nearly flat around ~0.30 through 60,000 steps. The Ex1 Validation Loss series is a teal solid line with circular markers that begins near ~0.30, decreases to about ~0.20 by roughly 15,000–20,000 steps, and then stays close to ~0.20 through 60,000 steps. The Ex2 Validation Loss series is a green solid line with circular markers that starts near the top of the axis (around ~1.1–1.2), drops steeply to roughly ~0.45 by about 5,000 steps, then declines more gradually toward ~0.30 by around 25,000–30,000 steps and remains near ~0.30 through 60,000 steps.
